h: Your Trusted Source for IT & Consumer Electronics
subpages.text: Skip to content Home About Us Brands Home About Us Brands Contact Us Your Trusted Source for IT & Consumer Electronics Contact Us Our Story​ Founded in 1996 in Kenya, Sapphire Trading and Marketing Ltd. began as a regional distributor of industrial food ingredients and hospitality commodities. Over the years, we expanded across East Africa—including Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, and the DRC —establishing a strong foundation in distribution. With the leadership of Mr. Nishit Raikundalia and strategic direction from Mr. Vinodchandra Raikundalia , we built a company rooted in trust, efficiency, and long-term relationships. In 2006, the entry of Mr. Sawan Raikundalia marked our bold diversification into consumer electronics and mobile technology. Today, we are a pan-African technology distributor, partnering with global brands like Anker, Belkin, Brother, DJI, Ecoflow, Hikvision, Samsung and Xiaomi . Serving wholesale, retail, corporate, and e-commerce sectors, Sapphire continues to expand across the continent—powering progress through innovation and adaptability. Our Mission​ To deliver innovative consumer electronics and solutions through trusted partnerships, agile distribution, and a relentless commitment to progress across Africa. Our Vision To be Africa’s leading force in technology and innovation—empowering communities by forging trusted partnerships, championing adaptability, and driving progress across markets.
